preconditions.description: The length of the input binary string s must not exceed 2000.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '01' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The input binary string s must consist only of characters '0' and '1'.

postconditions.description: The output binary string t must have the same length as the input string s.

postconditions.expression: all(s[l:r+1].count('0') + s[l:r+1].count('1') == t[l:r+1].count('0') + t[l:r+1].count('1') for l in range(len(s)) for r in range(l, len(s)))
postconditions.description: For any substring of s and t, the length of the longest non-decreasing subsequence must be equal.
The number of zeroes in the output string t must be at least the number of zeroes in the input string s.
